title: PRINCE2 Agile – AXELOS
overview: The PRINCE2 Agile certification course combines the PRINCE2 project management methodology with Agile practices to create a flexible and adaptive approach to project management. This course covers the principles of PRINCE2 and Agile, their integration, and practical application for managing Agile projects effectively. It is designed for professionals who want to manage projects with both structured project management and Agile practices.
audience: Project managers and team leaders using PRINCE2 and Agile methodologies.
Agile practitioners looking to integrate Agile practices with PRINCE2.
Professionals involved in project management who want to enhance their skills with a hybrid approach.
Individuals preparing for the PRINCE2 Agile certification exam.
methodology: Lectures and Presentations: In-depth explanations of PRINCE2 and Agile principles.
Hands-On Labs: Practical exercises to apply PRINCE2 Agile concepts.
Case Studies: Analysis of projects that integrate PRINCE2 and Agile practices.
Group Discussions: Interactive sessions to explore integration techniques and challenges.
Quizzes and Practice Exams: Assessments to evaluate understanding and readiness for the certification exam.
competencies: Integration of PRINCE2 with Agile approaches
Project management and delivery using a hybrid approach
objectivesIntro: By the end of the course, participants will be able to:
objectives: To provide a comprehensive understanding of PRINCE2 and Agile methodologies.
To develop skills in integrating PRINCE2 with Agile practices for flexible project management.
To prepare participants for the PRINCE2 Agile certification exam.
To equip participants with techniques for managing Agile projects within the PRINCE2 framework.
